collapse.lastLoss: 0.001-0.003 (saturated: the degenerate solution closes cycles perfectly)
collapse.mechanism: echo satisfies every round trip trivially (answer with the query, the cycle closes) and gradient descent finds it from BOTH starts — destroying the 1.00 forward skill it started with. The anchor does not save it: corrupting forward into echo is the easier gradient path. NOT a null (nothing learned): a specific wrong thing is learned fast and totally.

expectation: C1 PASS 2/3+, C2 PASS 3/3; scratch-cycle collapses (informative)
expectationResult: C1 missed 0/3; C2 tripped as premortemed; scratch collapses identically as predicted

heldOut.b4longReverse: 0.22-0.31 everywhere incl supmix (length does not transfer even with labels — separate bound)
heldOut.b5flipReverse: cycle arms 0.30-0.64 (echo-bed; uninterpretable), supmix 0.26-0.43 (format-flip of the NEW question fails with labels too — question-transfer is format-fragile)

reading: Answer-free cycle-consistency does not teach the reverse question — it teaches echo, and un-teaches forward. The failure is not lack of signal but a degenerate signal-satisfier the loss prefers. 'No labels' needs constraints that rule out echo, not purer unsupervisedness. Proposed (not run): semi-supervised — 16 labeled forward anchors (a pin, not a curriculum) + cycles; tests whether a tiny labeled pin blocks the echo fixed point while cycles do the real work.

supmixControl.reading: reverse IS learnable with answers (0.53-0.68 in 200 steps); the collapse is specific to answer-free cycles

verdict: C1 FAIL 0/3, C2 TRIPPED 3/3. Echo-collapse, replicated. The label-free round trip is a degenerate teacher.
